author: By Jaymes Langrehr
title: Madison police union issues vote of no confidence in Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway
text: In a release issued Monday morning, the Madison Professional Police Officers’ Association said the vote was the result of “many months of frustration in the absence of effective leadership from the Mayor.”

summary: The Madison police union issued a vote of no confidence against the mayor, citing months of frustration over an alleged lack of effective leadership.

author: By Adam Duxter
title: Madison group to begin recall effort against Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway
text: A Madison-based group says they plan to launch a recall effort against Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway.
